label: wsAP ac lite
description: MikroTik wsAP ac lite (RBwsAP-5Hac2nD) — 3x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: The wall socket is eth1 (E1) and eth3 (E3) sources. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/wsap-ac-lite/ (read 2026-11-28): "The device only accepts powering at the E1 port with PoE, so you must either a passive PoE injector (not included), or make sure your switch supports passive or 802.3af/at PoE output" and "The E3 port is capable of powering another RouterBOARD device with passive and 802.3af/at PoE. The maximum output current is 500 mA when using less than 30 V". https://mikrotik.com/product/wsap_ac_lite: Number of DC inputs 1 (PoE-IN), PoE in 802.3af/at, PoE in input Voltage 18-57 V, PoE-out ports Ether3, Max power consumption 20 W, Max power consumption without attachments 6 W. The inlet asks for 6 W, not the 12.95 W the class guess put on all three sockets; eth2 is poeIn: false.
